beats.headline: A coincidental spell book
beats.text: The rules are a little weird about taming dungeon pets, Mordecai says, while Mongo screams and hisses at him from his cage: remove the creature's hostility first, then come back. Then Carl and Donut open their boxes from the boss fight. Donut 'coincidentally' receives a spell book of Heal Critter; Carl gets another Potion of Determine Value and a thousand gold.

beats.headline: Mongo glows after the blast
beats.text: Heal Critter is on Donut's list now, at level one. Half the street where they were just standing explodes and throws them forward, rocks and debris raining over them, and Mongo squeals in pain. Then he glows as Donut casts Heal Critter, and she rushes to the small, blood-splattered dinosaur, clucking over him worriedly.

beats.headline: It worked, in capitals
beats.text: Up in the flying house in a storm, Donut sends Carl a message in capitals while he fights feral scorpions in a sandstorm: we did it, I cast Heal Critter, and it worked. She can't believe it. The health is still going down, though, and the stupid dog doesn't even appreciate it.

beats.headline: Not on a mount
beats.text: Weighing a vehicle against a mount, Donut points to her Twinkle Toes spell and her level-15 Heal Critter. Hedy the gremlin, on the floor fighting another gremlin, gasps that pet spells don't work on special mounts: neither Twinkle Toes nor Heal Critter will work on them.
